Privacy Policy

Last updated: June 2026

Tharwa ("ثروة", thrwa.co) provides market data and personal finance tools for users in Egypt. This policy describes how we handle information when you use our mobile app and website.

Information we collect

If you create an account, we collect the information you provide (such as email) to operate the app. We may collect usage and device information needed to keep the service secure and reliable. Contact form messages sent through our website are used only to respond to you.

How we use information

We use data to provide and improve the Tharwa app, support your account, and respond to support requests. We do not sell your personal information.

Third-party services

The app may use third-party providers for authentication, analytics, or infrastructure under their own policies.

Contact

Questions about privacy: thrwa.co/contact
